name: The 64 Gates Around the Wheel
description: The 64 hexagrams in the order of the Human Design wheel, with where each begins in the zodiac, the gate across from it, and the centre it belongs to. Positions and facts only: no Human Design text.

sections.The wheel: Human Design lays the 64 hexagrams round a circle and calls them gates. The circle is the zodiac: each gate takes 5 degrees 37 minutes 30 seconds of it (360 degrees divided by 64), and the first, gate 41, begins at 2 degrees Aquarius. This grammar lists the gates in that order. Everything on a gate's card is a position or a fact about the figure; none of it is Human Design's own text.
sections.The order: The order round the wheel is not the King Wen order (1, 2, 3 ...). It is the binary counting order that Shao Yong drew as a circle in the 11th century, the 'Fu Xi' circle: read the figures with the bottom line as the biggest digit and the order is two runs of counting, one up from 0 and one down from 63, joined into a ring. scripts/build_hd_wheel.py checks this for the list it uses.
sections.Lines: Each gate is cut into six lines of 0 degrees 56 minutes 15 seconds each (5 degrees 37 minutes 30 seconds divided by six). In Human Design, 'line' names that sixth of a gate, which is where a planet falls. It is not the same thing as a changing line in a cast; see the Schools of the I Ching grammar for that.

sections.Left out: Human Design's gate names and keynotes, the line texts of the Rave I'Ching, the descriptions of the channels and the Incarnation Crosses. They are Ra Uru Hu's writing, and Jovian Archive Media states that it holds the exclusive rights to it (jovianarchive.com, Terms and Conditions, Copyright notice). The wheel, the hexagram figures and the zodiac arithmetic are facts that anyone may state; the Florence court order of June 3 2020 says the same about the system as a whole (a system or method is not itself covered by copyright). We rely on the narrower point: we copy no text.
sections.Gene Keys: The Gene Keys use the same wheel and call the pair of opposite gates 'programming partners'. Their word lists and book text are not used here (Gene Keys Ltd reserves its rights, and bars use of its materials to train or operate AI systems). See docs/RESEARCH-gene-keys-and-human-design-2026-10-12.md.
